QUOTE: "**Execute** (`src/mcp/server_manager.cpp:153`). `is_denied()` is checked on the deny list. A match returns `Error: Permission denied for <tool>` as a tool result. This runs even when approval passed via `auto_approve` or the allow list."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says that deny is checked at execute time and that approval is a separate gate. It describes approval as also blocking (default-deny "Permission denied"). It never says that the deny list is the only thing that blocks execution or that ServerManager consults nothing else.
